description: Weekly plan from pregnancy through the first years: secure attachment, sleep, a calm home of faith, and keeping screens away.

topics.focus: A secure bond: your presence is the first lesson

actions.text: Spend ten minutes a day holding your baby, looking into their eyes and talking softly, with no phone.
Answer crying quickly and calmly; responding again and again builds security, it does not spoil.
Describe what you do while caring for them: "Now we change your clothes, now we wash your hands."
Pick a few calm words or a short supplication you repeat each time you soothe them, so your voice becomes a comfort.

topics.focus: Calmer sleep: the same routine every night

actions.text: Keep a short bedtime routine with the same steps every night: a warm bath, a feed, then dim lights.
Keep days bright and active and nights quiet and dark, so your baby learns the difference.
Lay your baby to sleep on their back in a cot with no pillows or toys; it is the safer way to sleep.
Put them down drowsy but not yet asleep, and repeat it patiently every night.

topics.focus: No screens in the first years

actions.text: Keep screens away at meals and before sleep, and replace them with talking and play.
Turn the TV off when nobody is watching; background noise cuts how much you talk with your child.
Video calls with relatives are the exception — and stay with your child during them.
Prepare a small basket of safe toys to explore with their hands instead of the phone.
Pray near your baby so they grow used to the sight and calm of prayer.
Let them hear a calm Qur'an recitation at the same time every day.
Say "Bismillah" aloud when you feed and dress them, so remembrance is familiar before they can speak.
Make du'a for your child aloud while holding them; they come to know your voice and the warmth of the moment.

worship.text: Pray one prayer together at home every day this week, with your baby close by.
Set aside five minutes after Maghrib to recite Qur'an aloud at home.
Make the morning and evening adhkar a shared habit between the two of you this week.
Give a small charity in the family's name this week.
Make du'a together for your child after one of the prayers each day.
